Gases

Gas Generation

Gas-generation models coupled to thermal reaction networks.

class liiontr.gases.generation.GasGenerationModel[source]

Bases: object

Compute gas generation rates from a reaction network.

Gas generation rates are returned in mol/s.

property species_names: list[str]

Return gas species names in deterministic state-vector order.

Species are ordered by first appearance in the configured reaction gas yields.

__post_init__()[source]

Validate the configured reaction gas yields.

Return type:

None

generation_rates(temperature, conversions, cell_mass)[source]

Return total gas generation rates by species.

Parameters:

  • temperature (float) – Cell temperature in K.

  • conversions (list[float]) – Reaction conversions in network order.

  • cell_mass (float) – Total cell mass in kg.

Return type:

dict[str, float]

generated_moles(initial_conversions, conversions, cell_mass)[source]

Return cumulative gas generation by species in mol.

Gas generation is calculated from the reaction conversion change:

n_i =

Y_i * m_cell * w_reaction * (alpha - alpha_initial)

Parameters:

  • initial_conversions (list[float])

  • conversions (list[float])

  • cell_mass (float)

Return type:

dict[str, float]

__init__(reaction_network, gas_yields)
Parameters:

  • reaction_network (ReactionNetwork)

  • gas_yields (list[ReactionGasYield])

Return type:

None

Ideal-Gas Pressure

Ideal-gas pressure models for battery free volumes.

class liiontr.gases.ideal.IdealGasPressureModel[source]

Bases: object

Ideal-gas pressure model for the free internal volume of a cell.

The model accounts for: - gas initially present in the free volume; - thermal expansion of that initial gas; - additional gas generated during thermal runaway.

Parameters:

  • free_volume (float) – Internal free gas volume in m3.

  • initial_pressure (float) – Initial absolute pressure in Pa.

  • initial_temperature (float) – Initial gas temperature in K.

__post_init__()[source]

Validate the ideal-gas pressure model parameters.

Return type:

None

property initial_moles: float

Return the initial amount of gas in the free volume.

The initial gas amount follows the ideal-gas relation

\[n_0 = \frac{P_0 V}{R T_0}.\]
pressure(temperature, generated_moles=0.0)[source]

Return absolute internal pressure in Pa.

The initial gas inventory is combined with the amount of gas generated since the initial state.

Parameters:

  • temperature (float) – Gas temperature in K.

  • generated_moles (float) – Additional gas generated since the initial state, in mol.

Return type:

float

pressure_from_total_moles(temperature, total_moles)[source]

Return absolute pressure from the total gas amount.

Parameters:

  • temperature (float) – Gas temperature in K.

  • total_moles (float) – Total amount of gas currently contained in the free volume, in mol.

Return type:

float

__init__(free_volume, initial_pressure=101325.0, initial_temperature=298.15)
Parameters:

  • free_volume (float)

  • initial_pressure (float)

  • initial_temperature (float)

Return type:

None

Venting

Compressible gas venting models for battery thermal runaway.

This module provides models for gas discharge through a battery safety vent. Both choked and subsonic compressible flow regimes are supported for ideal-gas mixtures.

Code written by François Dion (francois.dion@numericatech.ca, Numerica Techologies by LDV)

class liiontr.gases.vent.CompressibleVentFlowModel[source]

Bases: object

Compressible ideal-gas flow through a vent or orifice.

The model automatically distinguishes between choked and unchoked flow according to the downstream-to-upstream pressure ratio.

Parameters:

  • vent_area (float) – Effective geometric vent area in m2.

  • discharge_coefficient (float) – Dimensionless discharge coefficient.

  • heat_capacity_ratio (float) – Gas heat capacity ratio gamma = Cp / Cv.

__post_init__()[source]

Validate the compressible vent-flow parameters.

Return type:

None

property critical_pressure_ratio: float

Return the critical downstream-to-upstream pressure ratio.

Flow becomes choked when:

P_downstream / P_upstream <= critical_pressure_ratio

mass_flow_rate(upstream_pressure, downstream_pressure, temperature, molar_mass)[source]

Return gas mass flow rate through the vent in kg/s.

Parameters:

  • upstream_pressure (float) – Absolute cell internal pressure in Pa.

  • downstream_pressure (float) – Absolute ambient pressure in Pa.

  • temperature (float) – Upstream gas temperature in K.

  • molar_mass (float) – Mean gas molar mass in kg/mol.

Returns:

Vent mass flow rate in kg/s.

Return type:

float

Notes

The flow is treated as choked when the downstream-to-upstream pressure ratio is below the critical pressure ratio.

Reverse flow into the cell is not modeled.

molar_flow_rate(upstream_pressure, downstream_pressure, temperature, molar_mass)[source]

Return gas molar flow rate through the vent in mol/s.

Parameters:

Return type:

float

class liiontr.gases.vent.MixtureVentFlowModel[source]

Bases: object

Vent flow model for a gas mixture.

Total compressible flow is calculated using the mole-weighted mean molar mass of the mixture.

The total molar flow is then distributed among species according to their mole fractions.

__post_init__()[source]

None
